independence: Reimplemented from catalog columns; did not import or execute scripts/31_draft_numbers.py.

ep_kT_requested_definition_vs_pipeline_e.note: Not floating noise: scripts/31 uses standalone BAND_EP and LRT-selected BANDBB/CPLBB kT, not paired BANDBB_EP/BANDBB_KT over all valid Band+BB fits.

bounds.criterion_gate_railed: finite STATUS=OK shape parameter within 0.1% of either fitted bound, matching scripts/10 validity gate

poorly_constrained_energy_break_temperat.criterion: symmetric error >= absolute fitted energy, break, or kT estimate

errors.interpretation: MINOS NEG_ERR is expected to be negative; only NEG_ERR>0 or POS_ERR<0 is counted as an asymmetric sign violation.

AIC_arithmetic.criterion: stored AIC == stored N2LL + 2k to absolute tolerance 1e-8

strict.criterion: any 0.1%-gate rail, out-of-bound/inverted DSBPL, LRT<-1, invalid/disagreeing BEST_AIC, nonpositive symmetric error, error>10x fitted span, or AIC arithmetic failure

broad.criterion: strict plus LRT<-1e-6, nonfinite valid shape error, error>span, or asymmetric sign violation

flags.cause: scripts/31 uses standalone BAND_EP and an LRT>=14 kT selected from Band+BB first or CPL+BB otherwise.

flags.finding: Rows with no valid model are still assigned an invalid BEST_AIC_MODEL instead of INCONCLUSIVE.
Nominally nested children fit worse than parents, indicating unresolved local minima despite multistart.
flags.headline_effect: No negative-LRT child is a curvature winner, but the fits should be refit or invalidated.

flags.finding: Nested-LRT gates do not require a valid parent.
Validity ignores zero, failed-MINOS, and grossly unconstrained parameter errors.
The primary nu_m--nu_c fit uses all valid ordered DSBPL fits, not decisive two-break bins.
The exact 35/106 block fraction is dominated by a few highly resolved bursts.

two_break_fraction.verdict: Exact and threshold-stable as a block-weighted catalog statistic, but not robust as an unqualified population fraction because burst clustering is strong.

ep_kT.verdict: rho=0.81 is not anchor-dominated, but it is selection/definition-driven and is not the global same-fit Band+BB Ep-kT correlation.

verdicts.publication_readiness: Not ready to quote the Ep-kT, nu_m-nu_c, or unclustered 33% claims without the definition, fit-quality, and clustered-population fixes listed here.

recommended_actions: Resolve and document one Ep-kT estimand; if claiming Band+BB evolution, pair BANDBB_EP with BANDBB_KT and state any LRT selection explicitly.
Set rows with no valid model to INCONCLUSIVE and exclude them from literal BEST_AIC censuses.
For every nested pair, require valid parent and child and enforce child N2LL <= parent N2LL + tolerance; otherwise refit or invalidate.
Add uncertainty-quality flags for zero errors, MINOS failure/sign inversion, and energy/break/kT error >= estimate.
Report nu_m--nu_c only for decisive/error-constrained/boundary-clean DSBPL subsets, with all sensitivity slopes.
Report the two-break fraction with trigger-clustered uncertainty and burst-level/equal-trigger sensitivity, not only a block-level ratio.
